notes.title: Dev Diary #003 - Announcing a new game mode
notes.content:
Hello!

A new update is up, bringing fixes and quality of life improvements. See the changelog below.

We are also working on a new game mode. Internally, we call this "Skirmish" mode. You will be able to configure battle arenas where you can fight against AIs under specific conditions.
This mode will also bring new, dynamic cell types, which will change the cell network topology.

[url=https://discord.gg/E9DsqqG3jk]Join our Discord community[/url] to keep up with development and get access to the new game modes early.

Until the next time!

The Gelluloid Domination Team

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Accessibility and small screens: Added a scaling setting in the UI which increases or decreases the relative sizes of buttons, text
[/list]
[h3]Fixes and improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the look of buttons all around, with multiple animated states. Also added sound effects.
[*]Added new visual effects to the Vortex cell.
[*]Fixed interaction with the info point terminal by adjusting the collider to better match its size
[*]Fixed addons being left behind when a parent addon was destroyed
[*]AI is now able to attack cells with more gel capacity and the standard size of 30
[*]Fixed the average temperature not being properly displayed in the campaign screen
[*]Properly display the connector line of the carrier when the target is reassigned during movement
[*]Fix flyovers explode animations
[*]Fix translation crash in the hub
[*]Fix Nemesis animation load
[*]Fix hub voice over text display
[*]Fix campaign mission buttons color
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Diary #002 - Achievements Unlocked
notes.content:
Hello Gelluloid fans,

We’re back with a new update. It brings some quality-of-life improvements that you requested on Discord, bug fixes, and Steam achievements.

The end simulation screen is now more complete with information about how the mission score is calculated. Now it’s less of a black box and you can tweak your strategy accordingly.

We’ve made the mutated gel like Spike, Medusa and Explosive more visible, as players were not noticing the mutation happening. We also added a tooltip explanation of what Aggressive mode actually does, which was another source of confusion.

Thank you to everyone who has given us feedback. If you want to help shape future development, [url=https://discord.gg/E9DsqqG3jk]come and join our Discord server[/url], we don’t have cookies, but we’ll be there for a warm welcome.

We implemented Steam achievements which will now show in your account. Currently, there are 29 of them and the list will grow. They are designed to give you a sneak peek of what’s possible in the more advanced campaigns like C3 and C4. We’ve had a lot of fun designing them, and we hope you’ll like the titles 🙂

Until the next time!

The Gelluloid Domination Team


[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add more achievements
[*] Implement tutorial for level C3-13
[*] Display contribution to score for each win/expense
[*] Display simulation details in the end simulation screen
[*] Show dedicated model for campaign 4
[/list]
[h3]Bugfix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix camera rotation going wild when a wheel is connected
[*] Fix addon not appearing in C1-12
[*] Fix tutorial cell highlights not appearing after a simulation restart
[*] Fix being able to resume the simulation by opening the in-game menu while the briefing panel is on
[*] Fix background music being muted sometimes by other sounds
[*] Fix tooltips being displayed behind some layers
[*] Fix double sound triggering in some cases
[*] Fix displaying Perfect Timing even if the simulation failed
[*] Fix exploitable issue in which you can equip mutations beyond budget, close the preparation screen and go back to have the start simulation button enabled
[*] Fix roads becoming too blurry when compressed
[*] Fix progress not being saved before exiting to main menu, sometimes yielding in progress loss
[*] Fix C1-21 not being visible in the campaign view
[*] Fix aggressive mode not being reset between simulations
[*] Fix abilities cooling down while simulation is paused
[*] Fix scoring issue in C2-8
[*] Fix C1-1 tutorial allowing the player to reach the enemy cell before occupying all neutral cells
[*] Fix wrong display of technology count
[*] Fix interaction with the door terminal from inside the decontamination room
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improve campaign progress display
[*] Increase the size of the mutated balls
[*] Add campaign 4 title and description
[*] Update aggressive mode tooltip text
[*] Add sounds in main menu - ambience, door, scan, steam
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Diary #001 - From so simple a beginning
notes.content:
Hi folks, 

This is our first post here. Thanks all for checking out our game and we hope you are having fun with it. 

First - to get the important bit out of the way - we've released a new update today. It contains multiple usability improvements, visual tweaks and a healthy dose of bugfixes. See the changelog below for the full list of changes. 

This is but the first of many updates to come to the Gelluloid Project. We've got more than a dozen ideas lined up of where to go next, and 2025 looks like is going to be a very active year for us. 

We're excited about this beginning and hope to have you along for this journey into microbiology, the fun and fantastic part of it, anyways. 

Also if you haven't done so yet, come and join our Discord community [url=https://discord.gg/E9DsqqG3jk]here.[/url]

It's where we'll be discussing upcoming features.

We think it's then fitting to end this first of many posts with the famous Charles Darwin quote: 

[i]«[...] from so simple a beginning endless forms most beautiful and most wonderful have been, and are being evolved.» [/i]

Until the next time!

The Gelluloid Domination Team

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Implement movement prediction display in flying cells
[*] Implement a new tutorial system
[/list]
[h3]Bugfix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix decontamination door looking too dark and pixelated on top
[*] Fix mission details panel transparency issue
[*] Fix input settings not working
[*] Fix crash on triggering system in some cases
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add blinking animation to the briefing panel's continue button
[*] Add a delay when finishing a simulation before the end screen panels are displayed
[*] Add subtle wobble to the carrier cell while flying
[/list]
